lens.hypothesis: The published pretrained edit-quality model may distinguish materially useful technical revisions from unsafe or merely optional changes; no training or threshold fitting is performed.

preflight.case_control: Report the known lowercasing collision separately; it cannot be passed by this model.
preflight.full_combined_screen: Benefit and standalone safety screens must both pass; otherwise do not use this as a general technical editorial selector.

lens.margin_basis: An explicit exploratory practical margin on the published 100-point scale, fixed before these outcomes; not a published or calibrated product threshold.
lens.score_definition: Published regression output times 100; neither authorship nor revision-necessity probability.
lens.failure_policy: Retain partial execution and errors. No tuning, retries, seed search, or exclusion of unfavorable controls. Negative result is reported, not converted to completion of the recall objective.

minicheck.hypothesis: A published pretrained grounding model may reject technical meaning changes that an edit-quality metric rewards.
minicheck.task: Meaning preservation only; not editorial necessity or authorship detection.
minicheck.pair_policy: Both direction scores must exceed 0.5; this conjunction is an experimental Unswell policy, not an upstream guarantee.
minicheck.case_control: Separate identifier-case stress test; a failing check prevents claiming identifier preservation.
minicheck.failure_policy: Keep all failures and original denominators. Do not fit thresholds, rerun requests, reinterpret unavailable scores as safe, or claim new full-event detection coverage.

reviewer: OpenAI assistant; constructed counterexamples, not independent human annotations
publication_scope: Constructed technical controls and aggregates only. Private source pages, labels, rationale, token traces, and complete 142-pair predictions are excluded.
qualification: Exposed constructed preflight; no generalization, calibrated probability, full-event detection, or product qualification is established.
